locations.note: Purple aliens, the Grøbbers, have taken over Amsterdam, which the UN has evacuated and sealed in with a powerfield, and the player shoots a way through the city's real landmarks with five weapons.
One level is set in Centraal Station.
One level is set in De Wallen, the red-light district.
One level is set in Madame Tussauds, on Dam Square.
One level is set in the Rijksmuseum.
One level is set on the Dam, the square at the heart of Amsterdam.
One level is set at Schiphol airport.
